name: DeploySuccess
title: Templates/Platform/Creation/DeploySuccess
summary: The outcome screen a create flow ends on, in the terminal column of the wizard page: a heading with its lead and, for a Git source, the scope as a Tag; the deployment card with a preview tile, the service name with a Live Tag and its creation time, Visit site, the domain with Add custom domain, and the repository with its branch; the Resources list that tags each row Created or Bound; three Next steps cards that open the docs or carry on in the console; Get started with the CLI or GitHub Actions for a resource made from the CLI; and the Manage button. Any create flow can end on it, with its own title and, when there is no Git source, no scope. Built from `SectionHeader`, `Card`, `Tag`, `Button`, `Tooltip`, `Item`, `ToggleGroup` and `CodeBlock`.

variants.name: CliCreated
variants.summary: A resource made from the CLI that nothing serves yet: no deployment card, the resource as the only row, next steps that deploy it here (Recommended) or on a new service, and Get started with the CLI and GitHub Actions paths.
